title.narrative: Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund – Caribbean Hotspot Project

description.narrative: The project development objective (PDO) is to improve the capacity of civil society organizations to reduce threats to globally important biodiversity in the Caribbean Islands Biodiversity Hotspot.
